|---|---|
| Calories | |

| Sodium | ≤ 2,300 mg |

**Where the numbers come from:** e.g. maintenance calories from a TDEE calculator, minus 500 for about 1 lb/week.

**Adjusting:** e.g. if weight doesn't drop for 3 weeks, lower calories by 150.
